title: INPUT_IDLE_5M event
description: The idle prompt was shown. trigger says why: input_idle (threshold with no input, from ACTIVE), silent_call (silent-call cap, from ON_CALL) or input_pattern (a presence check for input without pauses or in a fixed rhythm, from ACTIVE, with pattern; ADR-0024). Absent means input_idle. See ADR-0003 §3 and ADR-0010.
